data.one_liner: Framework for implementing in-app purchases and subscriptions in Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: Adapty SDK helps implement in-app purchases and subscriptions in Flutter applications. It handles server-side receipt validation, paywall A/B testing, analytics, and no-code flow building.
use_when: You need a complete framework for in-app subscriptions and paywalls without managing custom server code.
You want to run A/B tests on prices and paywall designs without new app releases.
You require real-time analytics and third-party attribution for your subscriptions.
avoid_when: You want a minimal wrapper over native purchasing APIs with zero third-party cloud services.
You are not using in-app purchases or subscriptions in your application.
strengths: Supports no-code flow builder for native paywalls and onboarding screens.
Built-in paywall price and design A/B testing without redeployment.
Handles complex purchase workflows like free trials, refunds, and subscription management automatically.
weaknesses: Relies on a third-party hosted backend service (Adapty) for analytics and paywall configurations.
iOS native SDK distribution is handled strictly via Swift Package Manager.
data.setup_notes: Requires iOS Swift Package Manager configuration and minimum platform versions (Flutter 3.32.0, iOS 15.0, Android API 21).

alternatives.name: in_app_purchase
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want the official Flutter plugin for in-app purchases without integrating a third-party subscription backend.
